== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Imperial Squad Leader]]. Columns cover distinct published text states in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata and every Players Committee errata image; the stamp row describes the displayed rendition. Japanese and Virtual printings remain in Versions; a Revised, Unlimited or foil reprint whose printed words differ is a column. Yellow highlights mark changed words against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Imperial Squad Leader (Revised)]] has its own column (September 1998).
